race.comment: MAGIC SNITZEL (10) resumes from a spell of six-and-a-half months and is having her first outing under new trainer Maryann Brosnan. Finished sixth at Eagle Farm over 1200m at the opening run last time in work. Fitter for a minor placing in a recent Gold Coast trial. Leading contender. BUSTERBOY (11) is a Supido gelding on debut for the Foster yard. Has come along nicely at the trials and gets a key booking in Looker from the inside gate. Can make a bright start. DREAM INVADER (1) stepped out on his debut over 900m at Newcastle three weeks ago and finished seventh. Is sure to have come from that and will find this easier.
